import builtins
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print `[level] message` to standard output.

    Console output only: this function must not open or write any file.
    The level and message are used as given, with no case changes or
    other transformation, and the line ends with a single newline.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_basic_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "started")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] started\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_level_is_not_transformed(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("warn", "disk low")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[warn] disk low\n"


def test_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("DEBUG", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[DEBUG] \n"


def test_empty_level(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("", "hello")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[] hello\n"


def test_message_with_brackets_and_spaces(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "  [x]  failed  ")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[ERROR]   [x]  failed  \n"


def test_unicode(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "héllo wörld ✓")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] héllo wörld ✓\n"


def test_multiple_calls_each_on_own_line(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "one")
    log_line("ERROR", "two")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] one\n[ERROR] two\n"


def test_returns_none(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    func: Callable[[str, str], object] = log_line
    result = func("INFO", "x")
    assert result is None
    capsys.readouterr()


def test_does_not_open_files(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    def forbidden(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not open files")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_text", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_bytes", forbidden)
    log_line("INFO", "console only")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] console only\n"


def test_creates_no_files(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    log_line("INFO", "nothing on disk")
    capsys.readouterr()
    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
